proof_boundary.permitted_scope: Read-only static route/action/resource/permission/render-page and target-specific frontend call-site evidence at the audited commit.
proof_boundary.split_rule: No whole legacy-family route/page envelope is copied onto every split target. Route actions are allocated by exact job semantics. Shared routes/pages are enumerated explicitly.
proof_boundary.empty_page_rule: An empty page_ids array on a response-only route means no direct render page was proven; it never means the route or capability does not exist.
